name: Dak Mil butter avocado
summary: Butter avocado from Đắk Mil with thin, smooth skin and ripe yellow-green flesh that is sticky, fragrant, and free of fiber.
origin: The 2024 visitor handbook on the Dak Nong provincial portal and VnExpress’s handbook of 10 Sep 2023.
texture: The handbook says the skin is thin and smooth. Ripe flesh is yellow-green, without fiber, and sticky.
taste: The handbook says the fruit is fragrant.
seoTitle: Bo sap Dak Mil — butter avocado
seoDescription: Đắk Mil butter avocado, thin smooth skin, yellow-green flesh, no fiber.
